sources.quote: It has the traditional name Merga and the Bayer designation h Boötis; 38 Boötis is the star's Flamsteed designation.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 2.6 solar radii and 1.59 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,249 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
